answer: Slow-Accumulation Reputation Gate. Registration is free, but an identity's transaction capacity ramps only from non-transferable work receipts co-signed by a grove of independent verifiers. Under the lantern rule, each receipt decays unless renewed by continuing activity. Cloning therefore costs weeks of real labor per usable identity, while one honest identity compounds. Shared garden records make delete-and-recreate visible, so duplicates forfeit standing, and buying aged accounts costs more than earning them.
